name: BottomSheet
title: Components/Overlays/BottomSheet
description: A nonmodal, vertically resizable panel inside a bounded flex-column workspace. Fundamental Floating uses an inset and rounded corners; Fundamental sits flush. Drag the top edge, or focus it and use Up/Down (Shift for larger steps), Home and End. Optional header actions and footer stay visible while the body scrolls. Escape closes without trapping workspace focus.
purpose: Keep supporting records visible beneath a working area.
usage: This nonmodal, resizable panel belongs inside a bounded flex-column workspace. It preserves a minimum workspace height and supports keyboard resizing.

props.name: workspaceMinHeight
props.description: Space preserved for the workspace above the panel.
